intent.source: User requests and corrections through 2026-09-18; summarized, not quoted. See docs/dogeza-pet-feasibility.md for the evidence and proposal distinctions.
intent.definition: Innercast characters are custom pets in the host built-in Pets surface and can also appear as the same named subagent. The first requested prototype automatically performs dogeza on user frustration signals; its name and appearance are undecided.
journey: Create a dogeza character; do not silently substitute Forge or a work robot.
Install and observe it in the host built-in pet list.
Connect frustration signals to automatic dogeza, without requiring a button or pinching.
Invoke the same character as a named subagent and receive its result.
constraints: An agent role or browser demo is not a substitute for the requested native pet.
An automatic reaction to frustration is distinct from a manually triggered pose.
Pinching is a separate interaction, not the cause required for the automatic reaction.
Pet reactions should not recreate the apology-message loop that consumes model tokens.
The first character must perform automatic dogeza; its name and appearance have not been chosen by the user.
The same pet character must be usable as a subagent. A shared name alone does not prove shared state or a working connection.
Disclose detection costs before selecting the implementation. No runtime token or cost measurement has been performed.
Existing harness, compiler, and web tests are not native-pet or frustration-detector tests.
Read docs/dogeza-pet-feasibility.md for requirements, verified sources, missing tests, and retracted proposals.

harnessDefaults.source: Implementation choices for this harness, not additional user requirements.
harnessDefaults.completion: Record the actual target surface and runtime observation; tests alone do not establish native-pet integration.
harnessDefaults.reactionCost: Prefer no additional model inference for ambient reactions, based on the original token-waste concern. The user has not approved a detailed detection algorithm or a paid inference budget.

capabilities.description: Existing compiler and generated agent configurations; this is supporting code, not a pet installer.
Existing website and prompt preview; not native-pet execution.
No Innercast pet installation and host-list visibility evidence is recorded in this checkout. Inspect the installed host contract before implementing.
A prompt hook is documented, but not tested in this app session. A supported external native-pet animation-control path has not been found. No end-to-end dogeza execution exists.
No detector implementation or false-positive, false-negative, or cost measurements exist. Main-model classification was a proposal, not a verified free path.
Custom agent configuration is supported, but no dogeza pet package linked to the same callable character has been created or executed.
